      • conservativeCheckMemberAccess

        public static void conservativeCheckMemberAccess(Member m)
                                          throws SecurityException
        Does a conservative approximation of member access check. Use this if you don't have an actual 'userland' caller Class/ClassLoader available. This might be more restrictive than a precise member access check where you have a caller, but should never allow a member access that is forbidden.
        参数:
        m - the Member about to be accessed
        抛出:
        SecurityException

      • checkPackageAccess

        public static void checkPackageAccess(Class<?> clazz)
        Checks package access on the given class. If it is a Proxy.isProxyClass(java.lang.Class) that implements a non-public interface (i.e. may be in a non-restricted package), also check the package access on the proxy interfaces.

      • checkPackageAccess

        public static void checkPackageAccess(String name)
        Checks package access on the given classname. This method is typically called when the Class instance is not available and the caller attempts to load a class on behalf the true caller (application).

      • isPackageAccessible

        public static boolean isPackageAccessible(Class<?> clazz)

      • needsPackageAccessCheck

        public static boolean needsPackageAccessCheck(ClassLoader from,
                                              ClassLoader to)
        Returns true if package access check is needed for reflective access from a class loader 'from' to classes or members in a class defined by class loader 'to'. This method returns true if 'from' is not the same as or an ancestor of 'to'. All code in a system domain are granted with all permission and so this method returns false if 'from' class loader is a class loader loading system classes. On the other hand, if a class loader attempts to access system domain classes, it requires package access check and this method will return true.

      • checkProxyPackageAccess

        public static void checkProxyPackageAccess(ClassLoader ccl,
                                           Class<?>... interfaces)
        Access check on the interfaces that a proxy class implements and throw SecurityException if it accesses a restricted package from the caller's class loader.
        参数:
        ccl - the caller's class loader
        interfaces - the list of interfaces that a proxy class implements

      • isNonPublicProxyClass

        public static boolean isNonPublicProxyClass(Class<?> cls)
        Test if the given class is a proxy class that implements non-public interface. Such proxy class may be in a non-restricted package that bypasses checkPackageAccess.

      • checkProxyMethod

        public static void checkProxyMethod(Object proxy,
                                    Method method)
        Check if the given method is a method declared in the proxy interface implemented by the given proxy instance.
        参数:
        proxy - a proxy instance
        method - an interface method dispatched to a InvocationHandler
        抛出:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the given proxy or method is invalid.
